verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only client SDKs, API endpoints, and starter templates such as a Next.js App Router template with cookie-based auth. None of it documents prebuilt, customizable sign-in, sign-up, or profile UI components, or hosted auth pages. Starter templates and SDKs are developer building blocks, not the named capability, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As a developer, I can ship production sign-in, sign-up, and profile management with prebuilt, customizable UI components or hosted pages
